forms.name: Tide Fork
forms.note: The trident you woke with. Marta would like a word about the state of it.

forms.name: Kelp Tine
forms.note: Bram's otters found it. Light in the hand, quick to the next blow.

forms.name: Rime Fork
forms.note: Cold to hold. Frost runs down it when you breathe out.

forms.name: Forge Fork
forms.note: Reforged at the vents. Heavy. Still warm. Don't hit anything for a day.

forms.name: The Old Fork
forms.note: Kept in a box in the Vear family for three hundred years, in case.

outfits.name: Warden's Scale
outfits.note: The suit you woke in. The barnacles have mostly gone.

outfits.name: Gilded Harness
outfits.note: Parade dress from Meridon's stores. The Clerk has you down for it, in triplicate.

outfits.name: Cinder Mail
outfits.note: Marta made it. She says it's for your own good.

outfits.name: The Keeper's Mantle
outfits.note: What you were wearing the night you left the bell.
outfits.hint: At the end of the story.
